Trump Says US Is ‘Making A Fortune’
Sanders’ call follows Trump’s Wednesday remark at an Arizona rally, where he said, "Our country is making more money than it’s ever made because of the fact that oil is so high."

Trump said he "cared about the little person like crazy," but argued the U.S. is still "making a fortune." He said he rarely raises the point because he is "not happy until we get the actual price of the oil down."
He claimed gas was down to $1.85 per gallon, a level not seen nationally since the height of the COVID-19 pandemic.
